title: When the Summer Wakes
author: Emrys Vasquez
blurb: Rafael Hartwell, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
